about: A Lua mod made an item and an ability through TW3SE (w3.items, written to TW3SE's tw3se_items.xml) with the names of ItemXL's new item and ability: the report warns about each name once. Names only TW3SE makes are no warning.

warnings_contain: item 'ItemXL Example Blade' is made by ItemXL and by a TW3SE Lua mod (w3.items): rename one of them
ability 'ItemXL Example Blade _Stats' is made by ItemXL and by a TW3SE Lua mod (w3.items): rename one of them
